description: This file implements data retention and deletion logic for a SQL store in the Mattermost Focalboard project, including functions for querying and deleting old board-related data based on retention policies.

classes.name: RetentionTableDeletionInfo
classes.description: Struct holding information about tables and primary keys for data retention deletion.

methods.name: runDataRetention
methods.description: Executes data retention process, identifying and deleting outdated board data based on retention policies.

methods.name: idsFromRows
methods.description: Extracts IDs from SQL query result rows for deletion.

methods.name: genericRetentionPoliciesDeletion
methods.description: Performs deletion of data from specified tables based on IDs and retention policies.
